execution_precondition: Governing Master Plan must open the Alpha Research branch. Research preparation is not execution authorization.

phases.name: SOURCE / STATIC ADMISSION
gates: license identified and permissive-or-compatible; ambiguous licence => BLOCKED_LICENSE
source lock pinned (commit SHA + file SHA256 + config + params)
side-effect scan: no file writes, no mutation of shared state at import
network/download scan: no runtime fetch of code, pairlists or blacklists
future-indexing scan: no negative shifts, no .iloc[-1] on a full frame, no reindex to future timestamps
warmup/startup validation: startup_candle_count must cover the longest lookback

phases.name: ADAPTER PARITY
phases.rule: Original signal stream vs modernized signal stream must match exactly under a deterministic fixture.
phases.hard_rule: Any semantic difference means a NEW CANDIDATE, not an adapter.
phases.method: Run both forms over one frozen OHLCV fixture; compare entry/exit boolean series index-for-index; zero mismatches required.

phases.name: NATIVE TEST
phases.rule: Run at the candidate's intended market, universe, timeframe and slot configuration where scientifically feasible.
phases.note: For A7 this requires 40-80 pairs at 5m with four informative timeframes and DCA; not feasible on current data.

phases.name: NORMALIZED TEST
phases.rule: Shared Trading Lab OS controls, only where scientifically valid.
phases.hard_rule: NATIVE_RESULT and NORMALIZED_RESULT are always reported separately. BTC/ETH-only testing is never labelled native NFI validation.

phases.name: ROBUSTNESS - QUALIFIERS ONLY
phases.full_trial_count_rule: Must include lineage, source-selection and parameter-selection steps, not only the final visible runs.

controls.name: TrendRiderStrategy
controls.source_observed: -99.48% over 8y BTC/USDT 1h in the btc-strategy-lab benchmark

controls.name: matched-count random signal control
controls.definition: Random entries matched to the candidate's trade count and holding-time distribution.

controls.name: time-shifted signal control
controls.definition: The candidate's own signal series shifted by k bars, destroying timing while preserving signal statistics.

controls.name: exposure-matched passive control
controls.definition: Passive exposure matched to the candidate's time-in-market, so reduced exposure is never mistaken for alpha.

execution_order_principle: Eliminate weak candidates cheaply first. Do not schedule all candidates in parallel.

proposed_order.reason: Phase 1-3 static and parity work only; no new data needed.
Modern interface, no adapter; only meaningful paired with A3.
Broadens family coverage; weakest source evidence, so cheap elimination is appropriate.
Requires funding-rate acquisition and QA; only interpretable after A1.
Needs 4h data, the 'technical' package and resampling validation.
HOLD. Needs a 40-80 pair 5m dataset with four informative timeframes; not to be built during an active FP run.
